spec.text: Every number here is read from `otel.otel_traces`, the table the Collector writes. Agent figures come from the workflow's own `invoke_agent` spans (`gen_ai.operation.name='invoke_agent'`); model figures from the gateway's `chat` spans. The two are summed separately on purpose: added together they double-count (CONTRIBUTIONS item 5).

spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, count() AS runs FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanName='triage_run' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, sumIf(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), SpanAttributes['gen_ai.agent.name']='retriever') AS retriever, sumIf(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), SpanAttributes['gen_ai.agent.name']='analyser') AS analyser, sumIf(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), SpanAttributes['gen_ai.agent.name']='reporter') AS reporter FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name']='invoke_agent' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']!='' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

display.name: Reasoning tokens per agent (0 on a non-reasoning route)

spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, sumIf(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens']), SpanAttributes['gen_ai.agent.name']='retriever') AS retriever, sumIf(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens']), SpanAttributes['gen_ai.agent.name']='analyser') AS analyser, sumIf(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens']), SpanAttributes['gen_ai.agent.name']='reporter') AS reporter FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name']='invoke_agent' AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']!='' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

display.name: Agent outcomes (worst first: denied, truncated, empty, degraded, ok)

spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, countIf(SpanAttributes['triage.outcome']='denied') AS denied, countIf(SpanAttributes['triage.outcome']='truncated') AS truncated, countIf(SpanAttributes['triage.outcome']='empty') AS empty, countIf(SpanAttributes['triage.outcome']='degraded') AS degraded, countIf(SpanAttributes['triage.outcome']='ok') AS ok FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name']='invoke_agent' AND SpanAttributes['triage.outcome']!='' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

display.name: Model calls by the model that actually served them (litellm.provider.model, not the alias)

spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, countIf(SpanAttributes['litellm.provider.model'] LIKE 'ollama_chat/%') AS local_ollama, countIf(SpanAttributes['litellm.provider.model'] LIKE 'openrouter/%') AS remote_openrouter FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ServiceName='litellm-gateway' AND SpanName LIKE 'chat%' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, countIf(ServiceName='mcp-metrics') AS metrics, countIf(ServiceName='mcp-changes') AS changes, countIf(ServiceName='mcp-runbooks') AS runbooks, countIf(ServiceName='mcp-ops') AS ops FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'mcp-%' AND SpanName LIKE 'tools/call%' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, avg(Duration)/1e9 AS avg_seconds, max(Duration)/1e9 AS max_seconds FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanName='triage_run' AND Timestamp BETWEEN '{start}' AND '{end}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
